newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end mixed after nervous session.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end mixed after nervous session.

text.p: 1715 GMT - Portuguese shares closed mixed after a nervous session marked by exchange rate volatility and profit taking. Buoyed by optimism about the future of the wood-to-media group Inparsa, former Sonae Investimentos concerns that are being spun off, investors bought up the rights heavily to the new holding on Friday, the penultimate day of the offer. The rights closed up 18 escudos at 652 in trade of 2.01 million. Two rights buy one share in Inparsa, which groups Sonae Industria and Pargeste, whose interests range from construction through tourism to media.
* Dealers said 19.9 percent of tobacco company Madeirense de Tabacos changed hands, apparently in an internal reorganisation.
* Pension and investment funds squared positions on the last trading day of the month, boosting liquidity.
* Dealers expected light volume on Monday, although they did expect to see active turnover of Sonae rights.
